Commentary.Commentary: 135 is the target! This is not going to be easy against a good Oman attack. All to play for. Which team will head to Australia? Join us in a while to find out.

Hong Kong's head coach, Trent Johnston says that all the efforts they put in the training session have paid off. Hopes that they will bat well and overhaul the target. Adds that he just told his fielders to get their angles right on this ground. Feels that his players have put the best foot forward today and if they can't get 135, they don't deserve to go to Australia.

The Hong Kong bowlers were very good to begin with! More than their bowling, it was their fielding that was impressive. They stopped everything, the catching was great and it seemed like they would not miss the stumps tonight with their throws. Two direct hits saw them take two run outs. However, they will be disappointed with their overall effort. 100 at one point seemed difficult but the carnage right at the end, which the Hong Kong bowlers had no answers to, will now see them chase a tricky total.

A strong, strong finish for Oman! 50 runs in the last 3 overs have taken them to a score they surely will be happy with. Their dugout is ecstatic at the moment. Their coach especially as he is seen giving hi-fives to his skipper. The whole team walks out to applaud the effort of Singh and Naseem. It is because of the stand between the two, Oman are in this position. The chips were down after their top and middle-order crumbled. They were reeling at 42 for 6 at one stage. Singh though held one end up, scoring a fifty, he got able support from Kaleem as the two steadied the ship. Then came the fireworks. In walked Naseem and played a gem of a cameo. His quickfire stand with Jatinder has taken Oman to a score they can think of fighting.

SIX! This one has gone the distance! What a finish by Naseem Khushi. A clean hit. Khan dishes out a slower one, fuller in length around off. It falls right in the hitting zone of Khushi who latches onto it without fail. He gives it the full whack of his bat and powers it over the bowler's head for a maximum at long on. 18 from the final over and Oman have zoomed their total to 134/7!
A half-tracker on middle, it's pulled off the inside half to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Take that! Jatinder has mastered this Switch Hit! He has got more boundaries batting left than right. Picks up a length ball around off and smacks it towards third man for a boundary.

Smart bowling! A slower bouncer around off, Naseem is early into his pull shot and takes a blow on his helmet. That might have hurt although the batsman is not showing much pain. The ball has deflected to cover-point and they cross. It's given as a run. Hmm...may there was some wood involved.
The physio is out to have a look! A concussion test will take place just to check if everything is fine. That is done and we are fine to continue.
FOUR! Cheeky! Khushi has got the muscle but can innovate also. Fullish and on middle, Khushi moves across and neatly paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Naseem swings his bat at it and gets it away off the splice of the bat. It goes aerial and drops in no man's land near long on. Two taken.
Aizaz Khan to bowl the final over. 1 for 12 in his 3 overs. The skipper has been brilliant today.

This time it's not called a wide! Fuller in length outside off and well outside the tramline. Jatinder walks across the stumps and tries to poke at it. Misses. Looks at the umpire for a wide but nothing doing. 15 from the over!
Very full and on middle, it's knocked down to long on for one.
Called a wide! A touch harsh on the bowler. Sensing the shuffle across the off stump by the batsman, Rana bowls it wide outside off. Naseem pushes at it with an open-face but fails to connect.
Full again, wide outside off, Khushi smashes it again and hits it over covers. Good enough for a couple this time.

FOUR! Naseem has certainly got power. Full and wide outside off, Khushi reaches out for it and blazes it over covers. The fielder in the deep runs across to his right but fails to cut off. 28 runs in the last 9 balls. Oman on the charge!
SIX! Dismissed! Lovely pick-up shot from Khushi and his first scoring shot is a biggie. A slower one from Rana, it's just outside off, Naseem picks it up and deposits it over square leg.
Slower short ball outside off, Singh drags his pull shot wide of mid on and takes a run.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single. 17 from the over!

What was that? Keeper is up and the bowler has bowled a bouncer out of sheer frustration. Poor Scott McKechnie! Singh tries his best to pull but misses. No chance for Scott and it goes over him. The batsmen cross for a couple of byes. 100 up for Oman!
Third man drops back.
FOUR! Oman move to 98! Fullish and on middle, Singh reverse sweeps it wide of short third man and fetches another boundary in this over.
FOUR! Crucial runs! Short in length and on off, Jatinder stands tall and pulls it with authority to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Back of a length ball on off, Singh mistimes his shot  back to the bowler.

SIX! Fifty for Jatinder Singh, his third in this format and he brings it with an audacious Switch Hit! With the keeper up, the length became predictable. As soon as Christie drops it on a fuller length around middle, Singh brings out his innovative shot and nails it over backward point. He has played a gem of a knock here but without much support!
Kyle Christie returns into the attack. The keeper is up to the stumps.
On a driving length outside off, Khushi swishes and misses.
Naseem Khushi is the new batsman.

OUT! Kaleem tries to be smart but fails to execute his attempted shot properly. Cleverly bowled by Rana. A slower one on a length around off, Kaleem walks across the stumps with the intention to spoon it over short fine leg. But since there is no pace to work with, he ends up mistiming it in the air. A simple catch for Mohammad Ghazanfar who moves across to his left to accept it. End of a 42-run stand, a handy one given the situation Oman were in!
FOUR! Nearly carried all the way. Short in length and around off Kaleem backs away to create room and smashes it over extra cover. It falls just in front of the rope.
This one skids back into the batsman from a fuller length around off, Singh forces it down towards long off from the inner half of his blade. They cross for one.
Wide! Short in length and outside off, Jatinder reaches out for it but misses. The keeper collects and breaks the stumps but Singh is safely in.

A miscued shot and there could have been a run out as well! Back of a length delivery around leg, Kaleem tries to pull but gets a bottom edge onto the pads. It deflects towards cover-point and they set off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Touch and go, that.
Starts with a length ball in the line of the stumps. It's a bit of an off paced delivery. Kaleem stays back and blocks it to the off side.
Change in bowling. Nasrulla Rana is back on. 1-0-4-1, so far from him.
A single to end! Very full and on the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Another leading edge but it is safe again! This is on off, Kaleem looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. A soft leading edge is produced back to the bowler.
Very full and outside off, this is hit to the man at covers.
Very full and on middle, this is jammed back to the bowler.
Now follows the boundary with a single as he whips it through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Another reverse sweep and another boundary. This is fired outside off, Singh hits it nicely over the point fielder and bags one more boundary. He is playing a gem here.
Leading edge but safe! Singh looks to whip this against the turn through the leg side but gets a leading edge which goes down towards long off for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Once again the reverse sweep is played to good effect. He gets into position early does Singh and lofts it over point for a boundary.
The leg spinner on off, it is worked through square leg for one.
Loopy ball on off, Kaleem pushes it to covers.
On middle, this is worked down towards long on for two.
Good fielding again! Shorter and outside off, this is cut hard to the man at point. The fielder there dives and stops it.
Flatter and on middle, Kaleem clips it through mid-wicket. They take one and have to settle for it.
On off, Singh works it with the turn through mid-wicket for another run.
Fired on the pads, Kaleem works it through mid-wicket for one.
This is worked with the turn through mid-wicket for one.
The physio is out in the middle to check after Jatinder Singh. Some issue with his fitness but he is ready to face the ball now.
Ouch! That must have hurt! This is short and on middle, it skids through. Singh looks to pull but misses and is hit on the body. He down on his haunches at the moment.
On middle, Singh looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. A soft leading edge is induced to covers.
Ehsan Khan is back. His figures so far reads 2-0-5-1.
Another dot to end as this is once again flicked to the left of the bowler.
Good fielding! This is worked to the left of the bowler. He dives, stops it and does not let the batters take the run.
Flatter and on middle, it skids through. Singh is a touch late to get his bat down. It goes off the inner half towards the leg side for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and outside off, this is guided to point.
Shorter and around off, the batter looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Mohammad Ghazanfar is back. 1-0-5-1 are his figures so far.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for Oman! Singh innovates, he brings out the reverse sweep and gets it fine on the off side. Need a few more quickly.
A dot to end! This is on off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and on middle, it is worked towards short fine leg for another single.
Outside off, this is driven through cover-point for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two leg byes! This is on the pads, Kaleem looks to flick but misses. It hits the pads and goes down towards fine leg for two.
On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, Kaleem cuts it through point for one.
Wide! Down the leg side, the batter looks to paddle but misses.
Shorter and outside off, it is cut towards point for no runs.
Three dots in a row! One more ball on middle, Kaleem lunges and keeps it out.
On off, it is pushed towards covers.
Well bowled! This is angled into the off pole, it pitches and spins away. Beats the outside edge of the bat. The keeper takes it and whips the bails off, an appeal but not given.
Ehsan Khan is back on.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Kaleem flicks it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Loopy delivery on off, Jatinder drives it towards mid off for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Kaleem flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Kaleem plays it to point.
Driven towards the mid off region. One run added to the total.
Flighted delivery on middle, Singh flicks it to mid-wicket.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! It is all falling apart for Oman here. This decision is a tad unlucky though as replays show that there was an inside edge. Once again a bowler who is bowling his first over strikes. Ghazanfar lands it on off and then it turns back in. Khan looks to defend but there are two noises, one is off the ball hitting the pad. A huge appeal, the umpire shakes his head initially but then raises his finger.
Floated delivery on off, Singh plays it towards covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Jatinder flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Mehran flicks it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
On a length on off, Khan plays it to covers.
Short delivery on middle, Jatinder pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.

OUT! Taken on the second attempt! Half the side back in the hut and the score has not even crossed 50. Hong Kong all over Oman at the moment. The offie strikes in his first over itself. It is the arm ball, it is quicker and outside off. Kumar looks to punch it through the off side but there is a thick outside edge. McKechnie fails to take it on the second attempt but to his luck, it pops up nicely and he grabs it on the second attempt.

Excellent fielding! The paddle sweep is out from Singh. It goes towards short fine leg. The fielder there runs to his right, dives and stops it. It is an excellent stop as the ball had almost passed him but he really did well to stick his left hand out and stopped it.
Turn there! This is on middle, Kumar looks to flick but it hits the pad and rolls towards short fine leg for one.
Works it with the turn towards short fine leg for a quick run. The misfield from the fielder made the run easier.
Slightly shorter and on the body, it is pulled towards short fine leg for one.
Tosses it up on off, it is defended.
Ehsan Khan is into the attack.
A little too straight this is clipped towards fine leg for one. Another over which accounts for a wicket.
Good length and on middle, this is eased down to long on for an easy run.
Suraj Kumar is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! The Oman dressing room is shell-shocked at the moment. They just can't understand what is going on. What shot was that? Was it needed at the moment? NO! Nadeem has literally gifted his wicket to Hong Kong. It is a length ball outside off, Nadeem swings but the ball takes the top edge and lobs towards third man. It is a skier. Barkat settles under it nicely and takes a good catch. Oman slip further.
Good length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Confusion again but safe! This is on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket. They take one and then think of a second but the striker sends the non-striker back in time.
Shorter and around off, this is pulled through square leg and a single is taken.
On a length on off, Nadeem plays it towards point. Oman are 28/3 after 6 overs. A top Powerplay for Hong Kong.
Full on middle, Jatinder plays it towards the off side for a single.
Length delivery on off, Jatinder lofts it safely over covers. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Short delivery on middle, Singh looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On a length on middle, Nadeem flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Singh nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Kyle Christie is back on. 1-0-4-0 are his figures so far.
Good length and on middle, it is kept out. Another successful over comes to an end. Three wickets in the last three overs.
Good fielding again! Hong Kong have their tails up at the moment. This is a little too straight. JS works it towards short fine leg where the fielder dives to his left and stops it. A single taken.
Mohammad Nadeem is the next batsman in.

OUT! Huge mix-up and it is another run out! Oman in disarray at the moment. But what fielding here from Oman. They have had two chances to run the batter out, they needed to hit the stumps directly on both the occasion and they have done so. It just seems they are up for this game and are hungrier than their opponents who look really nervous at the moment. This is also a good wicket as Zeeshan can really be dangerous. This is on off, Zeeshan taps it towards cover and takes a start. Singh is off, Zeeshan hesitates but then sees Singh is almost beside him. He then goes for it. Kinchit Shah picks the ball up, realizes he has a lot of time, aims and then hits bull's eye at the non-striker's end. ZM walks back with his head down.
Nicely played! This is slightly shorter and around off, it is dragged through backward square leg for one.
One more short ball and width on offer, Zeeshan cuts it towards third man for one.
Shorter but closer to the off pole, it is guided to point.
Aizaz Khan is back on. 1-0-4-0 are his figures so far.

Edged but short! Well fielded though! This is fuller and around off, Zeeshan looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It lands well short of the fielder at first slip who dives, gets a hand to it. It goes down to third man for one.
Good length and on middle, this is kept out.
Good length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Zeeshan Maqsood is the new man in.

OUT! Direct hit and run out! The batsman is standing his ground, he believes, he was in. Hong Kong do not care though as they are on cloud nine at the moment. Excellent start for them as they have two early wickets. This is full and on middle, Singh works it towards mid on and takes a start. Ilyas starts rushing towards the other end but is sent back. Nizakhat Khan picks the ball up, takes aim and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. Ilyas did dive but that did not save him.
On a length on middle, Singh flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
FOUR! Bowls it on the pads, Jatinder flicks it easily towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
Haroon Arshad is into the attack.

FOUR! Streaky! Almost drags it on! This one is brought back in from outside off, it is on a length. Ilyas looks to guide it down to third man but that shot is not on. It goes off the inside edge, past the leg pole and down to the fine leg fence. A boundary to end but a top class over by Rana.
Beaten! This is a top, top over till now! Goes very full this time and outside off, it shapes away a touch too. Ilyas goes after it but misses.
A dot! Slightly short and outside off, it is cut to point.
Aqib Ilyas is the new batsman in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Hong Kong draw first blood and that too early on. A big wicket as Khawar Ali played really well in the last game. This is a nothing shot to be honest, his eyes were off the ball, he was trying to swing at it blindly and pays the price. This is a length delivery and outside off, Ali throws the kitchen sink at it. The ball kisses the outside edge and it goes to the keeper who takes. The Hong Kong players are pumped up. Just the start they would have wanted.
Very full again and on off, Ali strokes it back to the bowler who fumbles but no runs conceded.
Swing and a miss! Full and outside off, Khawar throws his bat at it but gets beaten.
Nasrulla Rana is into the attack.
Full delivery on off, Ali drives it towards point. The batsmen cross ends.
On a length on off, Singh guides it towards third man. The batsmen cross ends.
Good length delivery on off, Jatinder defends it out.
On a good length on off, Singh defends it off the back foot.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Singh looks to go after it but misses it.
Short delivery on middle, Khawar Ali pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Leading edge but safe! Shorter and on middle, Ali looks to work it on the leg side but ends up getting a leading edge which lands safe on the off side.
Kyle Christie to bowl from the other end.
Another good run! Good over though by the Hong Kong skipper. One more length ball on off, this is guided towards point for one.
Good running! This is on off, it is dropped towards cover for a quick single.
KA is off the mark now! This is angled into the batter, it is worked towards mid on for one.
Gets it right now and lands it on off, Ali defends it nicely.
Well fielded! Saves three at least for his side. Shorter and outside off, Ali cuts it hard towards point. The fielder there dives to his left and stops it.
Extra bounce! This is slightly short and on middle, takes off after pitching. Singh does well to play it with soft hands towards square leg for one. Oman are underway.
We are all set to begin. Khawar Ali and Jatinder Singh will open the batting for Oman. Aizaz Khan will start the proceedings for Hong Kong.

Aizaz Khan, Hong Kong skipper says he wanted to bat first too but they need to bowl well now and restrict them to a low total. Adds that they are doing well and they head into this game with confidence. Informs they are playing the same side.

Zeeshan Maqsood, Oman skipper says they would want to put up a good total and then defend it as chasing is tough. Adds they would want to play well today and fightback. Ends by saying he will try his best and hope he can lead from the front. Informs they have two changes - Mehran Khan and Naseem Khushi come in place of Sandeep Goud and Khurram Nawaz.
Hong Kong (Playing XI) - Nizakat Khan, Aizaz Khan (C), Kinchit Shah, Haroon Arshad, Simandeep Singh, Waqas Barkat, Scott McKechnie (WK), Mohammad Ghazanfar, Ehsan Khan, Kyle Christie, Nasrulla Rana.

Oman (Playing XI) - Jatinder Singh, Khawar Ali, Aqib Ilyas, Aamir Kaleem, Zeeshan Maqsood (C), Suraj Kumar (WK), Mehran Khan (IN FOR SANDEEP GOUD), Naseem Khushi (IN FOR KHURRAM NAWAZ), Mohammad Nadeem, Fayyaz Butt, Bilal Khan.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Oman. Oman have won the toss and elected to bat first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 4th playoff between Hong Kong and Oman at Dubai. The winning side will directly qualify for the ICC T20 World Cup. Oman lost their previous encounter but have a second chance to make it to Australia. Hong Kong on the other hand, have no other chance, if they lose tonight, they are out. A lot is at stake here.
